subject: Error when changing legend key labels

messages.author: 20a857807016d58a
messages.subject: Error when changing legend key labels
parts:
Dear all,

first of all, the attached plot does not make any sense, it's just
meant as
proof of concept/minimal example.
My question is why the (gg)plot leads to an error? [or rather, why
does the scale_colour_manual() call leads to an error]

Cheers,

Marius


require(ggplot2)

## toy data
set.seed(1)
str(df <- diamonds[sample(1:nrow(diamonds), 1000),])

## for plotmath in panel strips
lcol <- levels(df$color)
df$color.labs <- factor(df$color, levels=lcol, labels=paste("alpha==",
lcol, sep=""))

## for plotmath in legend key labels
lcut <- levels(df$cut)
n <- length(lcut)
legend.key.labs <- lapply(1:n, function(n.) bquote(italic(n)==.(n.)))
# legend key labels
cols <- hcl(h=seq(15, 375-360/n, length=n)%%360, c=100, l=65) #
default colors

## plot
ggplot(df, aes(x=carat, y=price, colour=cut)) + geom_point() +
facet_grid(clarity ~ color.labs, labeller=label_parsed, scales =
"free") +
geom_text(data=data.frame(), aes(1, 8000, label="alpha==1"),
parse=TRUE) +
annotate("text", label="beta", x=2, y=5000, parse=TRUE) +
labs(x=expression(alpha=="Carat"), y=expression(alpha=="Price")) +
scale_colour_manual(values=cols, breaks=1:n,
labels=legend.key.labs)
## => Error in data.frame(colour = logical(0), shape = 16, size = 2,
fill = NA, :
## arguments imply differing number of rows: 0, 1

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Multiple versions of a package installed, was Re: Error when changing legend key labels
parts: Addressing just one small part of your post below.

On 8/31/2011 11:02 AM, Marius Hofert wrote:
>
> I know that one can have several R versions installed, but I am not
> sure if one can install several versions of a package (?).

In a single library, you can only have one copy of a package. But you
can have multiple libraries, each with one copy. The devtools package
makes this easier.

I have the release (0.8.9) version installed in my standard library
("C:/Users/diggsb/R/win-library/2.13" for me) and a development version
in a development library. I run dev_mode() in devtools which adds
~/R-dev as a library. In that library the 0.9 version is installed (and
that library is before the standard ones). So if I turn dev_mode on,
and then run library("ggplot2") I get the development version. If I
don't (which is standard), I get the production version. Of course,
only one can be loaded at a time, but I can choose per R session which.

--
Brian S. Diggs, PhD
Senior Research Associate, Department of Surgery
Oregon Health & Science University

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Error when changing legend key labels
parts:
Hi,

That is because "breaks" in scale_colour_manual is incorrect.
Here is a minimal example:

ggplot(df[1:10,], aes(x=carat, y=price, colour=cut)) + geom_point() +
scale_colour_manual(values=cols, breaks=1:n, labels=legend.key.labs) #
NG
ggplot(df[1:10,], aes(x=carat, y=price, colour=cut)) + geom_point() +
scale_colour_manual(values=cols, breaks=lcut, labels=legend.key.labs)
# OK

--
Kohske Takahashi <takahash...@gmail.com>

Research Center for Advanced Science and Technology,
The University of  Tokyo, Japan.
http://www.fennel.rcast.u-tokyo.ac.jp/profilee_ktakahashi.html

Dear Kohske,

thank you very much, that indeed solved it.
It works with the development version. Without, one obtains the error as indicated below.
When do you expect the "new" version of ggplot2 to come out / incorporate these things so that one is not required to use the development version?

Cheers and keep up the good work,

Marius

## http://stackoverflow.com/questions/5293715/how-to-use-greek-symbols-in-ggplot2
## install_github("scales")
## install_github("ggplot2", "hadley", "develop")
## install_github("ggplot2", "kohske", "feature/new-guides-with-gtable")

# require(devtools) # (*)
# dev_mode(TRUE) # (*)
require(ggplot2)

## toy data
set.seed(1)
str(df <- diamonds[sample(1:nrow(diamonds), 1000),])

## for plotmath in panel strips
lcol <- levels(df$color)
df$color.labs <- factor(df$color, levels=lcol, labels=paste("alpha==", lcol, sep=""))

## for plotmath in legend key labels
lcut <- levels(df$cut)
n <- length(lcut)
legend.key.labs <- lapply(1:n, function(n.) bquote(italic(n)==.(n.))) # legend key labels
cols <- hcl(h=seq(15, 375-360/n, length=n)%%360, c=100, l=65) # default colors

## plot
ggplot(df, aes(x=carat, y=price, colour=cut)) + geom_point() +
facet_grid(clarity ~ color.labs, labeller=label_parsed, scales = "free") +
geom_text(data=data.frame(), aes(1, 8000, label="alpha==1"), parse=TRUE) +
annotate("text", label="beta", x=2, y=5000, parse=TRUE) +
labs(x=expression(alpha=="Carat"), y=expression(alpha=="Price")) +

scale_colour_manual(values=cols, breaks=lcut, labels=legend.key.labs)
## works with (*) (devel-version)
## without using (*):
## Error in data.frame(italic(n) == 1L, italic(n) == 2L, italic(n) == 3L, :
## could not find function "italic"
